# Generated by cpp-anything bridge for legacy.cpp (target: gcc 13, c++23).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(legacy LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

add_library(cppan_port_legacy STATIC src/port.cpp)
# The shadow library links this statically: the port must be position independent.
set_target_properties(cppan_port_legacy PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(cppan_port_legacy PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_compile_features(cppan_port_legacy PUBLIC cxx_std_23)
if(MSVC)
  # /Zc:__cplusplus makes __cplusplus tell the truth; without it the
  # static_assert in profile.hpp cannot pass.
  target_compile_options(cppan_port_legacy PRIVATE /W4 /permissive- /Zc:__cplusplus /utf-8)
else()
  target_compile_options(cppan_port_legacy PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow)
endif()

add_executable(cppan_driver src/main.cpp src/dispatch.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cppan_driver PRIVATE cppan_port_legacy)

# The shadow library: the same port, callable from the original's runtime so both
# can run on real traffic and be compared (`cpp-anything shadow .`).
add_library(cppan_shadow_legacy SHARED src/shadow.cpp src/batch.cpp src/dispatch.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cppan_shadow_legacy PRIVATE cppan_port_legacy)
set_target_properties(cppan_shadow_legacy PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME cppan_shadow)
